tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind panels and the sidebar seam. Never put body text directly on it in tables.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, chart plots, the default table body.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, filter bar, pressed states. ink-muted still reads on it (5.0:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on every surface and cell fill. Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: row labels in sub-rows, axis titles, descriptions. On surface, surface-sunken and all cell fills.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, units, axis tick labels, placeholder text. 4.5:1 or better on surface, surface-sunken, cell-locked.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on header-1 and on solid-ink buttons and tags.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between table rows, card edges, chart gridlines. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: 2px rules: under table headers, double rule above grand totals, chart baselines, active tab underline.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, editable cells and secondary buttons (3.4:1 or better on surface and surface-sunken, both themes).

tokens.name: header-1
tokens.usage: Tier-1 table header and the top band of a grid: column names. Text in ink-inverse.

tokens.name: header-2
tokens.usage: Tier-2 table header: period groups (Q1, Q2, H1) spanning tier-1 columns. Text in ink.

tokens.name: header-3
tokens.usage: Section rows inside a table body (e.g. 'Operating Expenses'). Text in ink, weight 700.

tokens.name: cell-input
tokens.usage: Editable cell ground. Always paired with a control-border inset and the input tick. Text in ink.

tokens.name: cell-input-hover
tokens.usage: Editable cell under the pointer before it enters edit mode.

tokens.name: cell-locked
tokens.usage: Read-only cells: actuals imported from ERP, prior-year figures. Text in ink-2.

tokens.name: cell-calc
tokens.usage: Formula / calculated cells: variances, totals of a row. Text in ink. Flagged by the ƒx glyph in its column header, never per cell.

tokens.name: cell-subtotal
tokens.usage: Subtotal rows. Text in ink, weight 600, single line-strong rule above.

tokens.name: cell-total
tokens.usage: Grand total row. Text in ink-inverse, weight 700.

tokens.name: cell-selected
tokens.usage: 2px inset outline of the active cell or range.

tokens.name: cell-dirty
tokens.usage: The 6px corner notch on a cell edited but not yet saved.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Monochrome fallback only: print, fax, forced-colours mode. Series 1 of a MEASURE chart (Actual) and the budget target tick on division charts. Solid fill, solid 2px line.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Monochrome fallback only: print, fax, forced-colours mode. Series 2 (Budget / plan). Solid fill; as a line, 2px dashed 6-4.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Monochrome fallback only: print, fax, forced-colours mode. Series 3 (Forecast / prior year). Solid fill; as a line, 2px dotted 2-3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Monochrome fallback only: print, fax, forced-colours mode. Series 4. Fill takes a 1px chart-1 outline (it sits under 3:1 on surface). As a line, dash-dot 8-3-2-3. Beyond four series use the hatch textures, then fold into 'Other'.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Monochrome fallback only: print, fax, forced-colours mode. Series 5 base fill, always with the 45° hatch in chart-1 and a 1px chart-1 outline.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: 'Other' / remainder slice and the empty track of donuts and progress bars.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Horizontal gridlines inside plots, 1px. Recessive by design.

tokens.name: div-contracting
tokens.usage: Contracting (blue). The ONLY colour this division ever takes, in every chart on every screen: bars, slices, lines, legend keys and the row key in tables. Never used for anything else.

tokens.name: div-facilities
tokens.usage: Facilities Management (saffron). The ONLY colour this division ever takes, in every chart on every screen: bars, slices, lines, legend keys and the row key in tables. Never used for anything else.

tokens.name: div-plant
tokens.usage: Plant & Equipment Hire (teal). The ONLY colour this division ever takes, in every chart on every screen: bars, slices, lines, legend keys and the row key in tables. Never used for anything else.

tokens.name: div-realestate
tokens.usage: Real Estate (rust). The ONLY colour this division ever takes, in every chart on every screen: bars, slices, lines, legend keys and the row key in tables. Never used for anything else.

tokens.name: div-corporate
tokens.usage: Corporate & Shared Services (orchid). The ONLY colour this division ever takes, in every chart on every screen: bars, slices, lines, legend keys and the row key in tables. Never used for anything else.

tokens.name: on-div-contracting
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a div-contracting fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-div-facilities
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a div-facilities fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-div-plant
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a div-plant fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-div-realestate
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a div-realestate fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-div-corporate
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a div-corporate fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: m-actual
tokens.usage: Actual (and Spent, and Forecast as a dotted line). Navy. Every actual/spend mark on every chart and the KPI progress fill.

tokens.name: m-budget
tokens.usage: Budget / plan. Slate. Bars, dashed lines; the reference series beside m-actual. Under 3:1 on white: keep its legend and labels.

tokens.name: m-committed
tokens.usage: Committed (purchase orders raised, not yet spent). Light navy, between m-actual and chart-other.

tokens.name: cat-labour
tokens.usage: Cost category: Labour (violet). Same colour in every cost-mix chart.

tokens.name: cat-materials
tokens.usage: Cost category: Materials (green).

tokens.name: cat-plant
tokens.usage: Cost category: Plant & fleet (sky).

tokens.name: cat-overheads
tokens.usage: Cost category: Overheads (raspberry).

tokens.name: cat-other
tokens.usage: Cost category: Other / everything under 5% (warm gray).

tokens.name: on-m-actual
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a m-actual fill (4.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-m-budget
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a m-budget fill (4.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-m-committed
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a m-committed fill (4.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-cat-labour
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a cat-labour fill (4.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-cat-materials
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a cat-materials fill (4.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-cat-plant
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a cat-plant fill (4.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-cat-overheads
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a cat-overheads fill (4.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-cat-other
tokens.usage: Labels printed inside a cat-other fill (4.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every focusable element. 3:1+ on all surfaces.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal dialogs and the cell-history drawer.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title on overview screens only. One per screen.

styles.name: kpi-xl
styles.usage: The single headline figure of a KPI tile. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: Secondary KPI figures, compact tiles, donut centre value.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Screen title inside the app shell.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Budget locked by Finance on 30 Sep 2026.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels, KPI captions, sidebar group names.

styles.name: td
styles.usage: Table cells. Always font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Cost-centre codes, GL accounts, document numbers. Never for amounts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Cell horizontal padding, control inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding (comfortable), legend gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), gutter between filter controls.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between dashboard tiles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side padding, gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of page to first section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large empty-state padding.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Table row height, dense mode (default for budget entry grids).

tokens.name: row-default
tokens.usage: Table row height, report mode.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: App sidebar width; collapses to 56px.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: App top bar height.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Table cells, headers, tiles, chart bars — the default. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Only the toggle switch track and the avatar.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers, card edges, gridlines.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Header underline, chart baseline, active tab, selection outline.

tokens.name: rule-double
tokens.usage: Above grand totals (accounting double rule).

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, the date picker. Panels and cards never take a shadow — they use a hairline.
